items.title: [工具自建] AI Baby Dance：基于 Kling 2.6 的baby照片转跳舞视频工具
items.author: Cuteprob
items.summary: 产品名称 AI Baby Dance 产品链接 产品描述 一个基于 AI 视频生成技术（Kling）的垂直应用工具。 目前市面上的通用文生视频模型（如 Sora 2, Veo 3）对于普通用户来说，提示词工程（Prompt Engineering）门槛较高，且难以控制人物的一致性。AI Baby Dance 旨在简化这一流程：用户只需上传一张静态的宝宝正面照片，选择预设的舞蹈模版（如 "Happy Bounce", "Disco"），即可在 2 分钟内生成一段保持面部特征的舞蹈视频。 核心特点： 技术实现：利用先进的 ImagetoVideo 模型，专注于保持人物面部特征的一致性（Consistency），同时自然地驱动身体动作。 隐私优先：考虑到用户上传的是儿童照片，强调数据隐私，生成的视频仅用户自己可见。 无水印下载：针对 TikTok/Reels 创作者需求，付费版提供无水印的高清视频下载。 极简操作：不需要编写任何提示词，将复杂的 AI 参数封装在简单的 UI 背后。 AI Baby Dance is a microSaaS that turns static baby photos into viralready dance videos instantly. Built on top of advanced video generation models (like Kling/Replicate), it solves the complexity of prompt engineering for everyday parents and creators. Users simply upload a photo and pick a dance move. The tool handles the character consistency and motion generation, delivering a fun, shareable video in under 2 minutes. It features a privacyfirst design with no watermarks on paid plans, making it ideal for social media content creation. 效果演示 (Demo) | 1. Upload Photo (上传照片) | 2. Choose Template (选择模版) | 3. Final Result (生成结果) | | :: | :: | :: | | width="200"/ | ▶️ 点击观看预览<br(Input Video) | 🎬 点击观看效果<br(Output Video) |

items.title: 【网站自荐】专为零基础学习者设计的 TypeScript 编程学习平台 | CodeInFlow
items.author: minmaxflow
items.summary: 作为两个孩子的爸爸，我想教他们学编程的时候，尝试过各种方案，但总感觉差点什么。一路摸索下来，就想着干脆自己做一个心目中理想的零基础学习平台。于是就有了CodeInFlow——一个真正零基础友好的编程学习平台。 CodeInFlow 是一个创新尝试：用 TypeScript 作为零基础青少年的第一门编程语言。 传统编程启蒙多用 Python 或 C++，但我们认为 TypeScript 更适合作为入门语言： 浏览器直接运行，无需配置开发环境 类型检查帮助减少错误，写代码时就能发现问题 AI 时代的主流编程语言，应用场景广泛 语法与 C++ 相近，后续切换到 CSPJ/S 竞赛要求的 C++ 非常顺畅 核心特色： 1. 真正零基础 从键盘指法和打字练习开始，涵盖编程符号、中英文输入法切换、常用快捷键等必备技能，7 节课程为编程学习做好充分准备。 2. 即时反馈循环 课程讲解与可运行代码无缝融合，每个示例都可在浏览器中直接编辑运行，让学习验证即时发生 3. 抄写模式 培养代码直觉和语法语感。 4. 系统化学习 从语言基础到算法 60节课程，5个学习阶段循序渐进： 核心编程概念：变量、数据类型、条件判断、循环、函数、面向对象 算法思维启蒙：栈、队列、排序、搜索、贪心、递归、动态规划 网站地址：

items.content:
[GitPortrait](https://gitportrait.refined-x.workers.dev) 是一个专注于将 GitHub 开发者数据转化为可视化画像和可分享卡片的创新平台，为程序员和工程师提供个性化的代码贡献分析和 AI 驱动的洞察。

## 核心功能

### 多维度数据可视化

- **GitHub 数据深度分析**：自动分析用户的代码贡献、仓库活跃度、技术栈偏好等多维度数据
- **可分享卡片生成**：一键生成精美的个人开发者画像卡片，支持多种模板（Linktree、Flomo、Multidimension、AI Portrait 等）
- **排行榜系统**：公开的开发者排行榜，展示活跃度和贡献度排名，激发社区参与

### AI 驱动的智能分析

- **四阶段 AI 流水线**：通过 Analyzer → Insight → Gaze → Writer 四个阶段，生成结构化的开发者画像分析
- **AI 画像生成**：基于 GitHub 数据自动生成个性化的 AI 画像，包含开发者风格、技术偏好、工作习惯等深度洞察
- **技术栈智能识别**：自动识别和分析项目使用的技术栈，包括前端框架、后端技术、开发工具等

### 零门槛使用体验

- **GitHub OAuth 一键登录**：无需注册，使用 GitHub 账号即可快速开始
- **浏览器直接使用**：完全基于 Web，无需安装任何软件或插件
- **实时数据同步**：自动同步最新的 GitHub 数据，确保画像始终反映最新状态

## 适用场景

- **个人品牌展示**：在个人网站、简历、社交媒体上展示开发者画像
- **团队招聘**：HR 和招聘经理可以快速了解候选人的技术背景和贡献
- **社区交流**：开发者社区中的个人展示和互动
- **自我洞察**：通过数据可视化了解自己的代码贡献模式和成长轨迹

---

**网站链接**：https://gitportrait.refined-x.workers.dev

items.title: Reloop - AI Transcribe & Loop
items.summary: AI-Powered Language Immersion: Transcribe & Smart Loop
items.content: We’re back on Product Hunt with our most requested feature yet. We know your reading list is growing faster than your free time. That’s why Reloop now allows you to convert any text, article, or note into high-quality audio material instantly. Whether you’re commuting, at the gym, or resting your eyes, you can now "re-loop" your knowledge through your ears. Don't just bookmark it—listen to it and master it.

items.title: Rich Calculation - Calculate decisions
items.summary: Calculate investment decisions — not just attractive returns
items.content: Most investment calculators show numbers that look good, but ignore real-world assumptions. Calc Rich helps you answer a better question: “Is this decision actually reasonable?” - Compound interest - Goal-based investing - Conservative vs optimistic scenarios Built for people who want clarity, not hype.

items.title: CodeQuest
items.summary: Master Programming One Quest at a Time For Free
items.content: I built CodeQuest because learning to code shouldn’t be limited to those who can afford it. Too many platforms hide quality content behind paywalls or push expensive bootcamps. CodeQuest is completely free, with 120+ courses and 11,000+ lessons. Learn Python, JavaScript, React, AI/ML, DevOps, and more. Choose a career path—Frontend, Backend, or Full-Stack—and follow clear roadmaps from beginner to job-ready. No credit card. No upsells. Just learn.

items.title: Open Configurator
items.summary: Transform the way customers configure & purchase products.
items.content: Open Configurator is a modern, full-stack product configurator that enables businesses to offer customizable products with real-time pricing, visual feedback, and seamless user experience. Perfect for businesses selling bicycles, generators, furniture, electronics, or any configurable products.

items.title: Spendulge
items.summary: Smart tool for smarter shared expenses
items.content: Spendulge helps friends, students, and roommates manage shared expenses in one place. Create a group, add expenses, see who owes what, and settle in one tap using your favorite payment method like PayPal, Venmo, Cash App, or Apple Pay — with amounts pre-loaded. Send in-app reminders for outstanding balances so no one has to send awkward follow-up texts.

items.title: Quantum Fluctuations
items.summary: Minimalist 3D logic puzzle
items.content: Void it is and to void it will return. Annihilate all the particles to win. There are 9 possible forms and colours for each particle. So you will go through 9 levels to get your record of least total moves. The physics of this game is strictly and realistically based on the standard model of the parallel universe PUg64, in which, unlike in ours, a single particle can never split or disappear.

items.title: Doodleboard
items.summary: Draw and share - your data never leaves your browser.
items.content: Doodleboard is a minimalist drawing app that runs entirely in your browser. No servers, no accounts, no tracking—your data never leaves your machine. Draw rectangles, circles, arrows, freehand sketches, text boxes, and sticky notes. Everything auto-saves to localStorage and compresses into the URL hash using deflate, so sharing your canvas is as simple as copying a link. Built as a single HTML file with zero dependencies. Works offline as a PWA. Fully open source—audit every line in minutes.

items.title: FaviconDIY
items.summary: FaviconDIY – Free favicon generator for developers
items.content: Create favicon.ico and PNG favicons online for free. Upload image, customize size, and download instantly. No login required.

items.title: XTrack
items.summary: Turn social media noise into clear signals
items.content: XTrack helps you turn social media into clear signals and intelligence source. You choose the people and topics you care about, and XTrack delivers concise AI-generated summaries on your schedule. Everything is in your hands, noise filtered, signals remains. XTrack is currently in beta. More sources, smarter summaries, and deeper customization are coming soon.

items.title: Riverside
items.summary: Create high‑quality content, edit fast, go live boldly
items.content: Riverside is an end-to-end platform for creating studio-quality videos and podcasts, from recording and live streaming to editing, repurposing and distribution, all with the help of powerful AI.
